name: Safflower Oil
siboNotes: Pure oils are SIBO-friendly and well-tolerated as they contain no carbohydrates to feed bacterial overgrowth.
preparationTips: Store in cool, dark place to prevent rancidity
Use within 6 months of opening for best quality
Choose cold-pressed varieties for maximum nutrient retention
Suitable for high-heat cooking with high smoke point
nutritionalHighlights: Rich in linoleic acid (omega-6 fatty acid)
